title: Define adapter protocol: discovery and streaming extraction with skip counters
description: Discovery finds sessions under given roots; extraction streams records without loading whole files (transcripts can exceed 100MB); malformed lines and unknown records are skipped and counted, never fatal. Done when: the protocol is typed and a reference in-memory adapter passes tests.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Typed protocol landed in src/importer.rs: RecordStream (pull-based streaming with skipped() counters and peak_buffered bound), SkipCounter (malformed/unknown), RawRecord, and MemorySource as the reference in-memory source (JSONL line-by-line, incremental discovery with last_discovery_new_ids, opens counter). All 6 contract.feature scenarios executable and green via tests/steps/importer_steps.rs; 17 features / 79 scenarios pass; fmt, clippy -D warnings, doc, doctests, spec coverage all green.

right_now_summary: The typed streaming protocol and in-memory adapter pass all six contract scenarios and 79 tests.
